rules.prepare:
RUBY_VERSION="2.7"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" touch config.guess config.sub tool/config.guess tool/config.sub bh_autotools_dev_update autoreconf -vfi
EXTRA_OPTS="" MY_BUILD_TYPE="$AELTRA_BUILD_TYPE"
if [ -e "/tools/bin/ruby${RUBY_VERSION}" ]; then EXTRA_OPTS="--with-baseruby=/tools/bin/ruby${RUBY_VERSION}" MY_BUILD_TYPE="$AELTRA_TOOLS_TYPE" elif [ -e "/tools/bin/ruby" ]; then EXTRA_OPTS="--with-baseruby=/tools/bin/ruby" MY_BUILD_TYPE="$AELTRA_TOOLS_TYPE" fi
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" mkdir .mybin ln -sf "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config" .mybin/pkg-config export PATH="$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/.mybin:$PATH"
# the configure script does not detect isnan/isinf as macros (from Alpine Linux) export ac_cv_func_isnan=yes export ac_cv_func_isinf=yes
if [ "$AELTRA_LIBC_NAME" = "musl" ]; then LIBS="-lucontext" fi
SHELL="$(which bash)" LIBS="$LIBS" \ "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$MY_BUILD_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --target="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --program-suffix="$RUBY_VERSION" \ --with-soname=ruby-"$RUBY_VERSION" \ --with-sitedir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/local/lib/site_ruby" \ --with-sitearchdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/local/lib/site_ruby" \ --enable-shared \ --enable-static \ --enable-ipv6 \ --with-dbm-type=gdbm_compat \ --disable-install-doc \ --disable-install-rdoc \ --disable-install-capi \ --disable-rpath \ $EXTRA_OPTS
rules.build:
export PATH="$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/.mybin:$PATH" cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR"
make V=1 SHELL="$(which bash)" -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "target" ]; then sed -i 's@/tools/bin@/usr/bin@g' rbconfig.rb fi
rules.install: export PATH="$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/.mybin:$PATH" cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make V=1 SHELL="$(which bash)" DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
